payload.name: Councillor Charlie Caine

attendance.note: CMIS counts the meetings a councillor was expected at over a rolling twelve months, so this window moves with the date the page was read. The council publishes how many of the missed meetings were apologised for, and both halves of that figure are shown here.

allowances.note: From the council's published schedule of allowances paid in 2024-25, matched on surname and initial. An allowance is not a salary: it is a set payment for doing the job. The schedule has four money columns — basic allowance, special responsibility, expenses and total — but prints a figure in only three of them for almost everyone, so the basic allowance and the total can be read off it and the middle figure cannot be told apart from expenses. This page therefore shows the basic allowance and the total, and says nothing about special responsibility.

interests.note: Norwich publishes this councillor's register as a scanned picture of the paper form, signed on 17 May 2024. A scan cannot be read as text, so nothing from it is reproduced here. The form itself is linked, and you can read it yourself.

payload.summary: Councillor Charlie Caine has represented Mile Cross ward since 3 May 2024. They sit on 2 of the council's committees and panels: Council and Planning Applications Committee. The council's committee system records them at 18 of the 26 meetings they were expected at in the 12 months to 8 September 2026. They missed 8, and the council records apologies for 7 of those. Their register of interests is published as a scan, so we cannot show what is on it; the form itself is linked.
